description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of various models on different morphosyntactic categories, comparing the performance of mBERT and XLM models across four categories: case, gender, number, and tense. The horizontal axis represents the categories, listed in the order of case, gender, number, and tense, while the vertical axis is labeled "effect" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, marked at intervals of 5. Each category is represented by a group of six bars, corresponding to different models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2, colored in light blue, dark blue, light green, dark green, pink, and red, respectively. The bars within each group are arranged in the same order as the legend, with the height of the bars indicating the effect, ranging from approximately 1 to 12. For the "case" category, the bars have values around 6 for mBERT-L2 and XLM-L2, 3 for mBERT-R2 and XLM-R2, and 12 for mBERT-B2 and 11 for XLM-B2. The chart does not display any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars. Error bars are present for each bar, indicating the range of the effect.
